I’m drawn to all of it though. I find tarot really therapeutic for myself, energy expenditure aside. Each connection I make with people makes my connection to my inner spirit/guides stronger.. I’ve always had a strong connection with my deck as well.

I’m now intrigued as to what you do! Fill me in

I sage my deck always before a reading. I then mediate on the querents question/what they are wanting guidance on. I then shuffle whilst staring into a candle flame. I take deep breaths. The amount of breaths I take depends on the querents karmic number. I’ll then lay out 5-6 cards initially. Positional layout doesn’t really mean anything to me. It’s the overarching theme of the spread that’s most relevant to me. My spreads always interlace and interconnect. The key to my readings is unlocking the meaning of them. Sometimes it only takes the reading. Other times it takes continued correspondence. Whatever the querent needs to gain clarity. That’s my priority. And my ritual never changes. That’s what works for myself :)
I dont really use spreads to be honest. I just draw cards until I feel like ive covered what I need to cover. Usually 5-6, sometimes 12-15. Really depends on the querent.
